statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-105544 is a .NET elevation of privilege issue in the VSTest test runner: its artifact postprocessor can consume a forged executionComplete.json written by another local user and run attacker-controlled output handling. The VSTest CLI ships inside the .NET SDK, and Microsoft fixed .NET SDK 9.0.1xx in 9.0.124, which bundles VSTest 17.12.1-hotfix-26528-39 (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/517, https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/issues/16654, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.23/9.0.23.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries; 9.0.23-r0 is built from the dotnet/dotnet v9.0.124 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v9.0.124), and its assemblies record that tag's commit, f4699d9. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build carries vstest.console.dll in the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and the Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI NuGet package in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts. In 9.0.12-r0 through 9.0.22-r0 (.NET SDK 9.0.113 through 9.0.123) both copies are VSTest 17.12.0-release-24508-01, and in both 9.0.23-r0 builds (.NET SDK 9.0.124) both are 17.12.1-hotfix-26528-39. The range ends at 9.0.23-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
